propositions: The authorship batching fixture's git merge command intermittently fails under xdist with exit code 1, but the stated cause (content conflict) is structurally impossible because both sides write byte-identical bytes to the only shared path and git merge-tree returns zero conflicts.

The fixture's _git() helper calls capture_output=True and discards stdout/stderr, rendering only the bare exit code in CalledProcessError, making it impossible to distinguish between content conflicts, failing hooks, and unresolvable merge arguments.

Extensive reproduction attempts spanning ~29,400 test executions (1,500 git sequence replays, 40 serial module runs, 72 oversubscribed runs, and 3 full test rounds under xdist) found zero occurrences of the failure.
The fix makes the failure diagnosable by surfacing git's stdout, stderr, argv, and exit code in the CalledProcessError message without changing the exception type or breaking existing catch clauses.
